name: @fatsolutions/tongo-sdk
description: Vendored build of Tongo SDK master branch (github.com/fatlabsxyz/tongo). The npm-published 1.5.0 has a broken proof-prefix ordering in its provers; master fixes it via cairo-abi-codec serialization. Vendored here (Apache-2.0) until the fix is published to npm. See DEPLOYMENTS.md.
